title: eval-harness: add prompt-set regression CI hooks and quality gating
author: Priya Natarajan
description:
Motivation: prevent regressions in prompt-sets and surfaced eval metrics from making it to production. This PR wires the eval-harness into our CI pipeline so that push/PRs run prompt-set regressions and evaluate configured quality metrics before merge.

What this change does: added a new GitHub Actions workflow (eval-gate.yml) that runs the eval-harness against a curated prompt-set, compares metrics to baseline thresholds stored in test/data/eval_baselines.json, and fails the job if any critical metric regresses beyond the configured tolerance. Adds an eval-harness --ci-gate flag that emits a machine-readable summary artifact and uploads it to S3 for historical tracking. Includes small API and config changes to support per-prompt-set thresholds and improved timeout handling for flaky prompts.

Checklist:
- [x] workflow: .github/workflows/eval-gate.yml
- [x] eval-harness: CLI flag --ci-gate + artifact JSON output
- [x] tests: unit tests for threshold comparator + integration test shim
- [x] docs: README section on CI gating and how to update baselines
- [x] infra: IAM least-privilege role for artifacts in infra/ci/roles.yaml (reviewed with security)

Notes and follow-ups:
- Baselines are intentionally conservative; we will tighten after 2 weeks of historical runs (ENG-7899).
- There's an optional flag --skip-storage for local debugging.
- This correlates with the new quality dashboard in Console (PM-341).

Elena Park: Minor: doc wording on when to bump baselines is ambiguous; reworded and added an example command.
Ava Chen: Approved after CI green and docs update.

Updated infra with least-privilege role; security has ACKed via ticket SUP-1123.
release_notes: Adds CI gating for eval-harness prompt-set regressions. New workflow .github/workflows/eval-gate.yml and --ci-gate flag. Stores evaluation artifacts for historical tracking. See docs/eval-harness/ci-gating.md for usage.
impact_summary: Improves guardrails against prompt/metric regressions by automatically evaluating prompt-sets in CI and failing PRs that introduce quality regressions. Initial rollout conservative; thresholds will be tightened after baseline runs.
testing_instructions: Run tools/eval-harness/cli.py --prompt-set test/data/prompt_sets/sample.json --ci-gate --output artifacts/local.json to locally validate. To run the CI workflow manually, trigger the eval-gate workflow in Actions and ensure CI role is configured.
notes_for_ops: Artifacts are stored in s3://redwood-ci-eval. CI role arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ci-eval-uploader (least-privilege). If artifact uploads fail, check STS assume-role logs in infra account.
security_review: security reviewed and ACKed (SUP-1123) - least-privilege role used, no secrets committed.
notes: This is a pragmatic first pass. Follow-ups: add Slack alerts on gated failures, surface detailed diffs in PR comments, and add deterministic seeding for flaky prompts (ENG-7899).
